# case: has printing successful handling info before failure
cd tmp1
! exec ssg init [--force]
cmp stdout ../expected_out_mix_failed.txt
exec ssg init --force
cmp stdout ../expected_out_mix_successful.txt


# case: only failed info
cd ../tmp2
! exec ssg init
cmp stdout ../expected_out_only_failed.txt
exec ssg init --force
cmp stdout ../expected_out_only_successful.txt


-- tmp1/index.md/_ --

  created   posts

initialization failed: 'index.md' is a directory, expected file (use --force/-f to overwrite)
-- expected_out_mix_successful.txt --
  modified  index.md (directory -> file)
  created   themes\default\index.html
  created   themes\default\post.html

initialization successful
-- expected_out_only_failed.txt --
initialization failed: 'index.md' is a directory, expected file (use --force/-f to overwrite)
-- expected_out_only_successful.txt --
  modified  index.md (directory -> file)

initialization successful
